items.title: The Big Question Hanging Over Netflix Stock
items.summary: With the stock already under pressure, the biggest risk for investors is a fundamental shift in how the company measures success, just as its growth is visibly slowing.

items.title: Paramount Wins EU Approval for $81 Billion Warner Bros. Deal
items.summary: Commitment to terminate its stake in European distribution venture with Universal Pictures eased regulators’ concerns.

items.title: Paramount gets EU approval for Warner Bros takeover despite US suit
items.summary: Investing.com -- Paramount Skydance Corp. received conditional approval from the European Union on Wednesday for its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., marking progress for the deal as it faces legal challenges in the United States.

items.title: EU OKs Paramount-Warner Bros. Deal With Concessions
items.summary: Paramount’s $81 billion bid to buy Warner Bros. Discovery was approved by the European Union on Wednesday after the companies offered concessions. In order to ease regulators’ concerns, Paramount offered commitments including that it would terminate its stake in United International Pictures in the European Economic Area within 13 months from the deal’s closing.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Sell WBD and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Over the past six months, Warner Bros. Discovery’s stock price fell to $25.96. Shareholders have lost 8.5% of their capital, which is disappointing considering the S&P 500 has climbed by 7.7%. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.

items.title: What Wall Street Pushed NFLX To Explain
items.summary: Netflix management is telling a new, more complex growth story, and on its latest call, analysts pressed to see if the numbers back it up.
